purpose: Define Style Editor as an AC-governed Expose MetaModule for editing canonical style tokens and managed assets without introducing parallel styling authority.

topics.name: Style Editor
topics.purpose: Define Style Editor as an AC-governed Expose MetaModule for editing canonical style tokens and managed assets without introducing parallel styling authority.

semantics.single_source_rule: Editor writes the one canonical style definition for its target scope.
semantics.preview_rule: Preview is a derived projection and does not become active style until explicit apply.
semantics.asset_rule: Asset management uses the Asset Registry rather than arbitrary path strings.
semantics.validation_rule: Candidate style validates token schema, required assets and references before activation.
semantics.rollback_rule: Previous accepted style version/state remains recoverable according to change policy.

invariants.rule: Web Base, style, assets and responsive layout define reusable presentation primitives only; they do not become semantic or runtime authority.

hard_gates.condition: Style Editor writes private parallel style model
asset selected by fuzzy path only
previous style state unrecoverable where rollback is required

prose.summary: Define Style Editor as an AC-governed Expose MetaModule for editing canonical style tokens and managed assets without introducing parallel styling authority.
